qualifier.query: select * from Messages where Status = 'Inprocess' ORDER BY _timestamp
select * from Messages where Status = 'Open' ORDER BY _timestamp LIMIT 1

pipelines.name: DeleteClosedOrderParameterMessages
pipelines.description: Deletes messages whose current state is 'Closed'.

stages.name: Read
stages.description: Reads all closed order parameter messages from the MsiMessages connection

stages.name: ForEach
stages.description: Iterates over each closed message to delete them individually

stages.name: DeleteMessages
stages.description: Deletes the message by _id and merges the delete operation result with the original message

stages.name: Return
stages.description: Returns the result of the delete operation for this iteration

triggers.name: CronTrigger
triggers.description: Triggers the pipeline every 30 minutes to clean up closed order parameter messages

pipelines.name: ProcessMSIRequestAndPublishResult
pipelines.description: Queries open messages, process them and send them to Pas-X.

stages.name: Filter
stages.description: Removes _id, _name and _timestamp from the row and retains them in metadata.filtered (used by SQLite to update the row by _id). Fans out to StringToObject and InprocessStatus.

stages.name: MsiMessageContainer
stages.description: Moves the parsed MsiMessageContainer into metadata.message so the original message can be rebuilt after the Weight parameter is added.

stages.name: WithUpdatedParameters
stages.description: Rebuilds the MsiMessageContainer_MsiOrderParameterMessage model from metadata.message, replacing the parameter array with the updated array (including Weight).

stages.name: XMLFormat
stages.description: Serializes the updated message model from JSON to an XML string for the MSI REST endpoint.

stages.name: SQLite
stages.description: Updates the Messages table row (matched on metadata.filtered._id) with the status payload from InprocessStatus, ClosedStatus or ErrorStatus.

stages.name: Weight
stages.description: Builds a ParameterDouble 'Weight' qualifier parameter with a formatted acquisition timestamp. Value is currently simulated (Math.random() * 10).

stages.name: OpenMessages
stages.description: Reads open MSI order parameter messages from the MsiMessages SQLite connection (OpenOrderParameterMessage input). Limit parameter sets the number of rows returned.

stages.name: InprocessStatus
stages.description: Sets the row status to Inprocess as soon as the message is picked up so it is not re-read on the next poll.

stages.name: ErrorStatus
stages.description: Failure path from PostMessage: sets the row status to Error and stores the MSI write error (metadata.writeResults[0]) as errorMessage.

stages.name: PostMessage
stages.description: Posts the XML message to PAS-X MSI via the MsiRESTClient PostMessage output. Success routes to ClosedStatus; failure routes to ErrorStatus.

stages.name: StringToObject
stages.description: Parses the stored message JSON string (event.value.message) into an object.

stages.name: AddWeightToParameters
stages.description: Appends the Weight parameter to the existing MsiOrderParameterMessage parameter array held in metadata.message.

stages.name: ClosedStatus
stages.description: Success path from PostMessage: sets the row status to Closed.

triggers.name: PolledTrigger
triggers.description: Polls for open messages every 5 seconds.

pipelines.name: ReceiveMSIRequestAndSendAcknowledge
pipelines.description: This is an API-triggered request/response pipeline that receives MSI (Message Service Interface) messages via HTTP, persists them to a SQLite database, and returns an XML acknowledgement response.

stages.name: TransferResultError
stages.description: Constructs an error response containing the message instance ID, system ID, success=false flag, and error details from the write operation.

stages.name: TransferResultSuccess
stages.description: Constructs a success response containing the message instance ID, system ID, success=true flag, and no error details.

stages.name: XMLFormat
stages.description: Converts the TransferResult JSON object into an XML string format for the response payload.

stages.name: Return
stages.description: Returns the XML acknowledgement response back to the API caller, completing the request/response cycle.

stages.name: MessageInsert
stages.description: Inserts the parsed message with Open status into the SQLite Messages table. Routes to success or error path based on insert outcome.

stages.name: XMLParser
stages.description: Parses the incoming XML request payload into a structured JSON object for downstream processing.

stages.name: AddOpenStatusUpdate
stages.description: Enriches the message object by adding a status field with value 'Open' to track message processing state.

stages.name: ObjectToString
stages.description: Converts the parsed XML object into a JSON string representation and wraps it in a message field for storage.

triggers.name: ApiTrigger
triggers.description: HTTP API endpoint that receives incoming MSI message requests and initiates the pipeline processing.
